correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructs edge-difference isomorphism and intrinsic Jacobian sqrt(n τ(G)), using τ(G)=product of cycle lengths; coarea gives 2^m sqrt(m) f_m(0) per zero-sum cube section. Conditional exchangeability yields cycle covariance m v_m/(m-1) and bridge covariance 1/3. Affine invariance and determinant algebra give the exact cycle Θ_m factors. Permutation symmetry and John contact decompositions give the product ellipsoid; rescaling yields explicit mixed-block anisotropy. Strict v_m<1/3 follows by conditional monotonic density weighting. The standard-library checker passed exact spline moments for m=3..12, spanning-tree identities on seven cactus examples, and four seeded numerical conditional-variance checks. Finite checks are not infinite proofs. No external validation.

value.rationale: Volume, isotropic constant, John ellipsoid and uniform inertia are canonical invariants of graph-derived convex bodies. The exact invariant (12L²)^d factors into graph cycle-length contributions, separating bridge count and arrangement from cycle geometry. Exact nontrivial factors 25/27 and 243/250 show quantitative loss relative to the cube. Adding arbitrarily many bridges makes L tend to the cube value but preserves a strictly nonisotropic John-position covariance; the triangle-with-bridge ratio 6/5 is independent of dimension and attachment topology. This is a natural structural family statement, not an arbitrary finite table or mere recomputation of known primal lattice volumes.
